Patsy Cline – Walkin' After Midnight / A Poor Man's Roses (Or A Rich Man's Gold)

Original Decca Records 7" 45 RPM single featuring two of Patsy Cline's best-loved recordings. "Walkin' After Midnight" helped launch Patsy Cline into country music stardom and remains one of the most iconic country recordings ever released.

A wonderful addition for collectors of classic country, rockabilly, and vintage Decca Records.

  • Artist: Patsy Cline
  • Title: Walkin' After Midnight
  • B-Side: A Poor Man's Roses (Or A Rich Man's Gold)
  • Label: Decca Records
  • Catalog Number: 9-30221
  • Format: 7" Vinyl Single
  • Speed: 45 RPM
  • Country: USA
  • Genre: Country / Traditional Country

Track Listing

Side A

  • Walkin' After Midnight

Side B

  • A Poor Man's Roses (Or A Rich Man's Gold)

Condition Notes WORN

  • Vinyl retains a good amount of original gloss.
  • Light to moderate scratches and sleeve scuffs visible throughout.
  • Labels exhibit age-related wear but are clean and legible.
  • No cracks, chips, or warping observed.
  • Record has been visually graded and has not been professionally play-tested.
